##### Project general facts

Hilton Residences Abu Dhabi Al Raha is a remarkable branded residential development by Emirates Developments, where the global legacy of Hilton hospitality is woven into the rhythm of everyday living. Rising across ten residential floors, the project delivers 176 beautifully crafted homes, spanning one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments, three-bedroom townhouses, four-bedroom apartments and spectacular five-bedroom penthouses. Owners are welcomed into a truly special world of privileges, including Hilton Honors Gold status for the duration of ownership, preferential rates at Hilton hotels worldwide, a dedicated concierge for travel arrangements and access to exclusive partnerships and experiences.

The resort-style amenities have been thoughtfully planned to nurture wellness at every hour of the day, with an outdoor swimming pool, a generous pool seating area, a well-equipped gym, a fitness studio, a sauna and dedicated changing rooms. Families are wonderfully looked after thanks to an outdoor kids' pool, indoor and outdoor children's play areas, a padel tennis court, a barbecue area, an outdoor cinema and an exciting VR room. Daily life is made effortless by an owners' lounge, a mail room, a beautifully landscaped courtyard for residents, basement and valet parking, and a 24/7 concierge who is always on hand.

The interiors draw on the sensory richness of the surrounding natural palette, blending the muted greens of coastal waters with soft desert neutrals, grounded by earthen browns and energised by a bold crimson accent. Natural tones and tactile materials come together in a harmonious balance of calm and contrast, carrying beautifully from the open-plan living and kitchen area through to the intimate bedroom and bathroom retreat. Elegant marble surfaces, fluted timber joinery, sculptural stone vanities and freestanding bathtubs give every space a refined, hotel-quality finish that feels both rooted and wonderfully luxurious.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Raha Beach is a captivating waterfront destination that embodies the essence of luxury and tranquility, nestled along the pristine shores of Abu Dhabi. This master-planned community seamlessly blends residential, commercial, and recreational elements in a harmonious coastal setting, redefining modern living with its stunning architecture, top-notch amenities, and panoramic views. The community's wealth of world-class facilities, including pristine beaches, exclusive gyms, and sports centers, cater to the diverse interests and preferences of its residents, while lush parks and landscaped areas provide serene spots for relaxation and socializing.

Al Raha Beach stands as a testament to Abu Dhabi's cosmopolitan charm, offering a lifestyle of opulence and tranquility that reflects the pinnacle of modern living. The community's exclusive clubhouse, retail outlets, and swimming pools, as well as its abundance of dining choices, landscaped lawns, and peaceful water fountains, all contribute to a sense of refined sophistication and elegance. As a destination for unparalleled leisure and recreation, Al Raha Beach invites residents to unwind by the water's edge, pursuit their passions, and indulge in the finer things in life.

The prestige and allure of Al Raha Beach are further enhanced by its four standout locations: Al Bandar, Al Hadeel, Al Muneera, and Al Zeina, each offering a unique character and charm that contributes to the community's overall sense of luxury and refinement. With its stunning natural beauty, world-class amenities, and sophisticated lifestyle, Al Raha Beach is a true gem of Abu Dhabi, a place where residents can experience the very best of modern living in a setting of unparalleled elegance and poise.
